BiblicalUsage: Quickly is the word for what God does without delay: His word runs very swiftly, the light of the righteous breaks forth speedily, and the spies run quickly to take the city. Moses tells Aaron to make atonement quickly, because the plague has begun.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that quickly is the speed of mercy: God's word runs swiftly, His light breaks forth speedily, and when the plague begins, the atonement must not wait — because delay is death.
